description: Vanessa inherited her relic gun from her father, and eventually had to face off against a young girl who had a relic gun of her own. The girl preached justice wherever she went, and thus the locals eventually surrounded Vanessa's gang of bandits in search of their own justice. Although Vanessa could've easily left it all behind and fled, her pride was such that she chose to stay behind and fight every single last one of her enemies. Having always manipulated others with fear, she now had to find something scarier than justice itself to gain back control. Thus, she challenged the young girl with the relic gun to a duel—a bullet heard around the world would decide their fate.
